caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile design with a light beige or tan background. The primary objects in the drawing are floral and botanical motifs arranged in a somewhat symmetrical composition. At the center left, there is a stylized yellow basket with blue and yellow flower arrangements emerging from it, featuring blue leaves and yellow buds. Above and to the right of the basket, there are additional large stylized flowers, mostly in yellow, with blue detailing and green leaves below one of the flowers. Scattered throughout the design are smaller circular shapes in yellow and blue, as well as brown and yellow flower clusters connected by green stems. Blue leafy vines form an arched pattern that runs horizontally across the lower half of the drawing, interspersed with brown flower clusters. At the very bottom edge, a zigzag black line is present above more decorative parallel blue and black lines. The lowest border features blue fringe or tassels hanging from the edge, further decorated with blue circular motifs between the tassels along the background. The color palette consists mostly of blue, yellow, brown, green, and black on a light-colored background.
title: Embroidery
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
